summary: V1 Vercel deploy-readiness verification after backend-URL migration from https://george-mcgs-cms.preview.emergentagent.com (pod preview) to https://belong-together.emergent.host (live production FastAPI). All acceptance criteria PASS. (1) Source-tree grep confirms ZERO remaining references to the old pod preview URL in ts/tsx/js/jsx across /app/website (excluding node_modules and the .next build cache which will regenerate on next build). (2) EXACTLY 23 references to the new URL 'belong-together.emergent.host' across ts/tsx/js/jsx source files — matches the review request expectation on the nose. (3) All 7 required local routes return 200 on http://localhost:3000: /, /meet, /about, /how-it-works, /features, /register-interest, /admin. (4) Pod preview URL https://george-mcgs-cms.preview.emergentagent.com still serves /meet → 200 and /register-interest → 200 as required (the pod's own preview URL is unaffected by the migration — only the FALLBACK constant changed). (5) lib/api-base.ts DEFAULT_API_BASE = 'https://belong-together.emergent.host' (no trailing slash, no /api suffix — correct). (6) next.config.js env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL fallback = 'https://belong-together.emergent.host' — matches. (7) RYI end-to-end sanity: POST /api/public/register-interest with a unique test payload (testing-agent-iter111-<ts>@friendplace-test.dev) returned 200 {ok:true,id:...}, row persisted in MongoDB interest_registrations with all expected fields (id, first_name, email, state_country, heard_from, companion_choice='george', source='website', status='new', is_test=false, ip, created_at). Row deleted immediately after verification; interest_registrations count = 0 confirmed both before and after the test — V1 guest book stays empty for launch. (8) UI smoke via Playwright: /meet renders 'Come in' + 'Meet George or Georgia'; /register-interest renders the four labeled inputs (First name, Email address, State or country — optional, How did you hear about FriendPlace? — optional) and 'That's my hello' submit button, no red-screen errors, no console errors. CONCLUSION: The migration is clean. The local build is fully deploy-ready to Vercel with NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://belong-together.emergent.host (or omitted — the code falls back to the same value).
